name: Write Release Notes From Evidence
summary: Write release notes from bounded Git evidence while separating verified changes, user impact, and unresolved claims.
description: Write concise release notes from an explicit Git revision range and supplied validation evidence, using a read-only collector to ground change statements. Use when preparing release notes, a changelog entry, or a release announcement.
risk_reason: This skill writes release notes from bounded Git evidence while separating verified changes, user impact, and unresolved claims; it does not publish, tag, push, or modify Git history.
refuses: It does not invent customer impact, performance, security, or compatibility claims from commit messages.
It does not publish, tag, push, or modify Git history.
It does not expose secret-bearing diffs or include unverified future work as shipped.

entrypoints.purpose: Collect a bounded Git revision range, commit list, and changed-file evidence without mutation.

operational.latency_reason: The skill writes release notes from bounded Git evidence while separating verified changes, user impact, and unresolved claims, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
